content.short: TVVIN solves the problem of limited access to real-world assets by tokenising precious metals and other assets.
content.description:
TVVIN is a blockchain platform that offers a wide range of real-world asset (RWA)-backed tokens. Our platform enables investors to capitalise on the unprecedented growth of the asset fractionalisation market by investing in liquid and tradable tokens denominated in grammes of precious metals and other RWAs.

We begin our operations by leveraging the inherent value of gold bullion to create a cutting-edge digital token, the TVVIN gold token ($VVG). This token is backed 1:1 by LBMA-certified gold bullion, providing investors with a secure and easily tradable digital representation of physical gold.

However, our ambitions extend beyond gold. TVVIN has the potential to tokenise other precious metals such as silver, platinum, and palladium, as well as non-traditional assets like intellectual properties, real estate, royalties, collectibles, and more. This expansion allows investors to diversify their portfolios and gain exposure to a broader range of valuable assets.

In addition to individual asset tokens, TVVIN offers a MultiRWA token ($TVVIN), which represents a proportionate share of multiple RWAs integrated within our platform. This innovative token allows investors to spread their investments across various assets while holding a single type of token.

TVVIN's native token, $TVVIX, grants access to the TVVIN vaults where investors can securely deposit their tokens over a specified period and earn yield.

By offering a diverse range of RWA-backed tokens, TVVIN provides investors with the means to access a variety of real-world assets in a digital and tradable format, expanding investment opportunities and fostering a more inclusive and efficient market ecosystem.

Tokenisation of gold and precious metals already exist on EVM compatible networks but TVVIN is a first mover in the emerging Cardano network and together with the unique ecosystem of tokens that comprise the MultiRWA token, the vaulting functionally and decentralised nature, TVVIN takes a unique position in the market.
